clauses.clause: Depot clerk scene plays: clerk hands over, walks back into the shop, closes the door; nobody vanishes.
clauses.note: All22 low/high frames personally inspected. Same clerk148/155 emerges through the shop door carrying parcel, gives it, waves and walks inside before the door closes. Both321-tick native strips include94 transfer ticks with zero simulation-hidden ticks; ownership actually transfers and final closed-door latch occurs. Seven negative controls pass. No outdoor disappearance observed; between-render drawn flags are diagnostic, not visibility proof.
